result.topic_en: A worked reduction of an induction observation series from 20 July: triples of scale readings are combined into pairwise sums, differences between alternating groups, divided by 8 and averaged, with temperature and time notes.

methods.what: Sums of consecutive pairs of three turning-point readings, then added together to give a damping-corrected group value
Differences between successive alternating group values (deflection measure)
Sums of consecutive differences divided by 8 to obtain the deflection in scale divisions
Arithmetic mean of the three reduced values
